provenance.duplicate_row_classification: Exact duplicate extra rows are repeated full-row fingerprints within a duplicate effective-key group; conflicting extra rows are distinct full-row variants beyond one representative per duplicate key. Counts are disjoint and sum to duplicate extra rows.
provenance.g8a_ordered_projection: Each GID_NO_V1 table is read once; the same rows feed duplicate and F5 statistics and storage_projection.project_ordered_rows using canonicalized gid/no column indices. Per-table status, diagnostic code and fixed message, row and gid counts are recorded without row values; blank gid rows are counted separately.
provenance.g8a_real_gid_duplicate_scan: For GID_NO_V1 ordered tables, duplicate-key grouping includes only real gids. Gid parsing and blank classification follow storage_projection._ordered._parse_gid_source; NULL, empty string, and integer 0 are blank and excluded. Unparseable gids are excluded from duplicate grouping and counted separately in ordered_projection.
provenance.pairing_owner_confirmation: Owner confirmed 2026-10-10: v1/v2 within one tier are the same project; different tiers are different projects and are not paired.
